1.w: Now I, Paul, myself exhort you⁺ by the mildness and gentleness of Christ—[I] who indeed as to presence [am] humble among you⁺, but being absent am bold toward you⁺.

2.w: Now I implore [you] that being present, [I need] not to be bold with the confidence with which I reckon to be daring toward some reckoning us as walking according to the flesh.

3.w: For walking in flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.

4.w: For the weapons of our warfare [are] not fleshly, but powerful before God toward the tearing down of strongholds,

5.w: tearing down arguments and every high thing lifting itself up against the knowledge of God, and taking captive every thought into the obedience of Christ,

6.w: and having readiness within to avenge all disobedience, when your⁺ obedience shall have been fulfilled.

7.w: You⁺ are looking at things according to appearance. If anyone has been persuaded in himself to be of Christ, let him reckon this upon himself again, that as he [is] of Christ, so also [are] we.

8.w: For even if I should boast somewhat more abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave [us] for building up and not for tearing you⁺ down, I will not be ashamed,

9.w: so that I might not seem as if to frighten you⁺ through the letters.

10.w: For they say, “The letters indeed [are] weighty and strong, but the presence of the body [is] weak, and the word is of no account.”

11.w: Let such a one reckon this, that such as we are in word through letters being absent, also such [we are] in deed being present.

12.w: For we do not dare to classify or to compare ourselves [with] some commending themselves. But these, measuring themselves by themselves and comparing themselves with themselves, do not understand.

13.w: But we will not boast unto the things without measure, but according to the measure of the area that God apportioned to us, a measure to reach even as far as you⁺.

14.w: For we are not overextending ourselves, as not reaching to you⁺. For we came also as far as you⁺ in the gospel of Christ,

15.w: not boasting unto the things without measure in others’ labors, but having hope [of] your⁺ faith increasing among you⁺ to be enlarged according to our area, to abundance,

16.w: so as to preach the gospel [in] the [places] beyond you⁺, not to boast in the things ready in another’s area.

17.w: But, “The one boasting, let him boast in the Lord.”

18.w: For the one commending himself, that one is not approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
